_what: How a run woken by a fact gets the whole value the fact only points at: a fact is at most 8 text fields of 1,024 bytes (trillion-rust src/wake/host-events.json), so a fact about a row names where it is, never the row. For a fact of a kind here, tool:run-workflow-definition runs `tool` with `input` (each value the name of the fact's field it is taken from) before the run's first step and gives the run its answer's first row as input[`into`]; derived records add `tool` to the runs of every workflow a wake of that kind starts (read-data/derived-records.mjs). A fact of a kind not here, or one missing a field, is given as it is.
